# Chapter 12

At 3 in the afternoon, Mara counted 27 windows along the station wall. The numbers mattered to her only because they kept her mind away from the letter in her coat pocket. When the train finally arrived, nobody on the platform moved for a long moment.

She had read the same paragraph twice before noticing the citation tucked into the margin note (Adams, 2019). The DOI on the handbill, https://example.org/study/42, was irrelevant to her journey, but the year 2018 still lingered in her memory.
